one_line: Last Thanjavur Nayaka ruler, caught in siege and dynastic turmoil in the 1670s.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s, medium height, dignified but battle-worn build.
appearance.face: Oval face, wheatish-brown South Indian complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed black moustache, faint worry lines at the brow, steady serious eyes with a calm, resolute default expression.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair pulled into a tight, modest knot at the back of the head, partly covered by a small dark maroon velvet turban wrapped low, with a slim gold band and a single teardrop ruby jewel at the front.
appearance.costume: A rich dark green silk angarkha-style long coat reaching below the knee, slightly flared and tied at the right side, with fine gold floral brocade and a narrow gold border at cuffs and hem; beneath it a cream cotton tunic with a simple round neck; deep maroon cotton pajama-style trousers gathered at the ankles; a broad gold-embroidered sash in muted saffron wrapped around the waist and knotted on the left side; simple dark brown leather sandals; jewellery limited to a thin gold chain, a pair of small gold stud earrings and a single signet ring on his right hand, all keeping the look royal yet restrained.
appearance.signature: A finely crafted straight South Indian steel sword with a gently tapering blade, a traditional Indo-deccani hilt with a disc-shaped pommel, and a plain dark brown leather scabbard worn at his left hip, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Vijaya Raghava Nayaka is a late-40s South Indian king with an oval wheatish face, black knotted hair under a maroon turban, in a dark green gold-brocade angarkha over cream and maroon garments, bearing a plain-hilted steel sword, in dark green, maroon, cream, saffron and gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vijaya Raghava Nayaka: a late-40s South Indian king with an oval wheatish-brown face, calm serious eyes, neat black moustache and straight black hair tied in a small knot beneath a low dark maroon velvet turban with a slim gold band and single ruby jewel. He wears a dark green silk angarkha-style long coat with fine gold floral brocade and narrow gold borders at the cuffs and hem, over a cream cotton tunic and deep maroon pajama-style trousers gathered at the ankles. A broad muted saffron sash with gold embroidery wraps his waist and is knotted on the left, and he stands in simple dark brown leather sandals. Jewellery is minimal: thin gold chain, small gold stud earrings, and one signet ring on his right hand. His signature weapon is a straight South Indian steel sword with a traditional Indo-deccani disc-pommel hilt, sheathed in a plain dark brown leather scabbard at his left hip, with his right hand resting lightly on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by dark green, maroon, cream, muted saffron and gold, and show him from head to toe in a neutral pose with clear views of face, hair, clothing details and sword.
